headline: Continued a variance request for a two-car garage addition at 37 West Albert Street to October 15.
summary: The request by Thuhong Vu and Danny Nguyen for an addition with a two-car garage at 37 West Albert Street was continued. The board also approved the 9/14/2026 minutes. Member T. Hovey was appointed to the Zoning Rewrite Steering Committee.

plain_text:
Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals Minutes 
9/28/2026 at 6:30 P.M.  
 
Note: These minutes are not completed verbatim. For further detail, contact the Division of 
Development Services, 375 Merrimack Street, Lowell, MA or refer to video recordings available online 
at www.LTC.org. 
 
Members Present: Chairman Pech, Member Procope, Member Hovey, Member Shanahan 
 
Members Absent: Member McCarthy 
 
Others Present: Peter Cutrumbes, Assistant Planner 
 
The following represents the actions taken by the Zoning Board of Appeals at the 9/28/2026 meeting. This 
meeting was held in the  City Council Chamber . Attendees had the ability to participate via Zoom as 
permitted by Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2025, signed into law on March 28, 2025. 
 
Chairman Pech called the meeting to order at 6:30 PM. 
I. Continued Business 
 
II. New Business 
 
ZBA-2026-33  
Petition Type: Variance  
Applicant: Thuhong Vu and Danny Nguyen  
Property Located at: 37 West Albert Street, 01851   
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Section 5.1  
Petition: The Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals will hold a public hearing to hear all interested 
persons relative to an application by Thuhuong Vu and Danny Nguyen to construct an addition with a two-
car garage underneath at 37 West Albert Street. The subject property is located in the Traditional Single-
Family (TSF) zoning district. The proposal requires a Variance per Section 5.1 for relief from minimum side 
yard setbacks and maximum Floor to Area (FAR) ratio and any other relief required under the City of 
Lowell Zoning Ordinance. 
 
On Behalf: 
Danny Nguyen of 37 West Albert Street, and his wife Thuhong Vu. They are seeking approval to put an 
addition on the house. It is a two car garage with two bedrooms above it. 
 
In Support: 
None
In Opposition: 
None 
 
Discussion: 
D. Shanahan had no questions. T. Hovey noted that the size of the sign for public notice was not large 
enough but he supports the project. G. Procope concurred. He noted the 5 conditions on the comment 
memo. One of them is that they need a site and utility plans. They also need shade trees. M. Briere is in 
favor but also noted the sign  requirements were not met . V. Pech explained the necessities of public 
notice signs and their dimensions. 
 
Motion: 
G. Procope motioned and M. Briere seconded to continue the project to 10/15. The vote was unanimous 
(5-0). 
 
III. Other Business 
Minutes for Approval:   
9/14/2026 
 
G. Procope voted to approve the minutes. Seconded by T. Hovey. The vote was unanimous (5-0). 
 
2027 Zoning Board of Appeals Schedule  
 
The Board noted no comments or concerns with the schedule. 
  
Appoint Member to the Zoning Rewrite Steering Committee  
 
G. Procope motioned to appoint T. Hovey to the steering committee. M. Briere seconded. The vote was 
unanimous (5-0). 
 
 
Adjournment  
 
G. Procope motioned to adjourn. T. Hovey seconded. The meeting was adjourned at 6:45 PM.
